summary: A church deacon asks members to let them know when someone is in the hospital so the church can visit.
realLife: A deacons' report invites members to share news of hospital stays, thanks volunteers warmly, and describes quarterly visits to hospitals, elder care, and homes.
sources: First Presbyterian Church of Yorktown, The Ministry of Our Deacons: https://fpcyorktown.org/deacons-commission-reports/the-ministry-of-our-deacons/
inGame: needs: churches and a visitation team; ties (friend, neighbor) can carry the news

turns.summary: The member does not want a visit and says so.
turns.writesBack: the deacon backs off; no tie change

turns.summary: The member tells the deacon after discharge.
turns.writesBack: a missed visit; a small apology

turns.summary: The member calls the deacon the same hour.
